credits.title: Prepaid credits
credits.summary: Deposit USDC once and spend it call by call from one balance. Close the account at any time and what is left goes back to the wallet that paid.
includes: Deposit USDC to a key's credit account
Calls charged from the prepaid balance
Closure refund to the depositing wallet after 72 hours
Balance and deposits in the dashboard

trls.title: Pay in $TRLS
trls.summary: Fund your balance with $TRLS as well as USDC. A deposit is credited at the token's price when it arrives, calls are charged in dollars as always, and $TRLS paid for inference is burned.
includes: Deposit $TRLS to fund a key
Credited at the price when the deposit arrives
Calls priced in dollars, with no markup
$TRLS paid for inference is burned

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.summary: Authorize a ceiling, pay for what you used, and get the rest back when the tab closes.
includes: Open a tab with a spending cap
Session-key vouchers per call
The unused part returned at close
Tab close posted by the router near the cap or expiry

facilitator.title: Hosted payment facilitator
facilitator.summary: Other sellers can verify and settle per-call payments through this router, without running payment infrastructure of their own.
includes: Verify a payment for another seller
Settle it on chain
Network fee paid by the router's relay key
No facilitator fee

sealed.title: Sealed lane
sealed.summary: Run a call on attested hardware and get the evidence with the answer: the measurement the router checked and the provider's own signed receipt.
includes: Models served from an attested gateway
Attestation checked before the request is sent
Measurement pin with every identifier the evidence carries
Attestation record on each receipt

anchor.title: Receipt roots in the anchor program
anchor.summary: The hourly receipt root is held by a program account instead of a memo, so anyone can read it from the chain's state without walking a key's history.
includes: One root account per hour
Receipt signing keys published and rotated on chain
Proofs checked against program state
Earlier memo roots stay verifiable as memos

media.title: Images and video
media.summary: Generate images and short videos from a prompt, each in a tab of its own, paid from the same balance and with a signed receipt for every generation.
includes: Images tab: one to four images per prompt
Video tab: a clip from a prompt, ready in minutes
Per-generation prices shown before you order
Files served by the router for 24 hours

holders.title: Holder tiers
holders.summary: Wallets that hold $TRLS get membership levels: higher limits, priority on the sealed lane when it is busy, earlier access to newly listed models, an advisory vote and a profile badge. A tier never changes a price.
includes: Tiers by $TRLS held, with fixed thresholds
Higher request and token limits per tier
Sealed-lane priority and early access to new models
Advisory vote and an opt-in badge

council.title: Council
council.summary: Put one question to several models at once and have their answers judged against each other, or have a second provider check the first. Every model that answered has its own receipt.
includes: One prompt, several models
A judged answer with the reasoning for it
Dual verification: a second provider checks the first
A receipt per model that took part

agents.title: Agent keys
agents.summary: Give an agent a key with a rulebook: a budget, per-call and daily caps, and a size above which it has to ask you first. Stop it at any time, and see what it spent and every decision the router made for it.
includes: Budgets and per-call and daily caps
Ask-first approvals, used once
Stop and resume at any time
An event log and an activity ledger with receipts

blind.title: Blind lane
blind.summary: Pay with single-use tokens the router signs without seeing them: bought from a balance, spent with no account or key, and not linkable by the router to the purchase. A call still arrives from your own network address: the oblivious relay and the onion address are not open yet.
includes: Blind-signed single-use tokens
Bought from a balance, spent with no account
Receipts that name the token, not an account
Not open yet: the oblivious relay and the onion address

estimate.title: Price check
estimate.summary: Price a prompt on every model before you call: the estimated cost at the listed price, the amount the router would hold on your balance while it runs, and whether it fits the model's context and output limits, cheapest first.
includes: POST /api/v1/estimate: a prompt and an output cap in, every text model priced out
The hold the router would place, not only the estimate
Context window and output limit checked per model
A Price check page in the workspace

pace.title: Pace alerts
pace.summary: Set a daily spend line on a key or the whole account and hear about it before it is crossed: when today's spend, at its rate so far, would reach the line by midnight UTC, a notice appears in the dashboard bell. An alert, never a cap: the key keeps working.
includes: A daily line per key or for the whole account
A projection of the UTC day at today's rate, checked every minute
One notice a day in the dashboard bell, and the optional webhook
Never stops a call

receipt-export.title: Receipt export
receipt-export.summary: Download your signed receipts for a date range as CSV or JSON, from the dashboard or the API. Each row keeps the receipt id, model, cost, time and signature, so every line can be verified later.
includes: Signed receipts for any date range
CSV or JSON, from the dashboard or GET /api/v1/generations/export
The signed payload, signature and key id on every row
Paged and bounded: up to 1,000 rows a page, 366 days a range
